t: The Rothenberger Pro-Cut Manual Rotary Copper Pipe Cutter is a robust tool designed for efficient and precise cutting of copper pipes. Its durable die-cast zinc construction ensures reliability for demanding trade use, making it ideal for plumbers and heating engineers. Featuring an 18mm wall clearance, this pipe cutter allows for accurate cuts on 22mm copper pipes, even in confined spaces. A replaceable steel cutting wheel maintains consistent performance, and ergonomic rubberised grips provide comfort and control during prolonged tasks. This tool is engineered for reliable, long-lasting operation on site.
b: Durable Springs for a Reliable Operation
